title: FedPA-LoRA: Product-Aligned Framework for Mitigating Aggregation and Initialization Errors in Heterogeneous Federated LoRA
abstract: arXiv:2608.15381v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient federated fine-tuning of large language models, but its factorized parameterization creates a tension between accurate aggregation of local updates and continuity of locally optimized factors. Factor-wise aggregation incurs aggregation mismatch but better preserves factor continuity, whereas product-space reconstruction reduces this mismatch at the cost of greater factor-level initialization mismatch from newly reconstructed factors. We propose FedPA-LoRA, a product-aligned federated LoRA framework that jointly addresses these limitations and provably converges under both homogeneous and heterogeneous client ranks. Each client preserves its local factors across communication rounds and aligns its product toward a rank-specific global reference, maintaining local optimization continuity while promoting global consistency under data heterogeneity. The server aggregates heterogeneous-rank updates

translated_title: FedPA-LoRA：缓解异构联邦LoRA中聚合与初始化错误的产品对齐框架
translated_abstract: 低秩适配（LoRA）能够实现大型语言模型的高效联邦微调，但其因子化参数化在局部更新的准确聚合与局部优化因子的连续性之间产生了矛盾。逐因子聚合会导致聚合不匹配，但能更好地保持因子连续性，而乘积空间重构虽减少了这种不匹配，却因新重构因子导致更高水平的因子级初始化不匹配。我们提出了FedPA-LoRA，一种产品对齐的联邦LoRA框架，它联合解决了这些局限，并在同构和异构客户端秩下都能证明收敛。每个客户端在通信轮次间保留其局部因子，并将其乘积对齐到特定秩的全局参考，从而在数据异构性下保持局部优化连续性并促进全局一致性。服务器聚合异构秩的更新。
tldr: 本文提出FedPA-LoRA，一种通过产品对齐策略在保留局部因子连续性的同时减少聚合与初始化错误，并在异构客户端秩下实现收敛的联邦LoRA框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes FedPA-LoRA, a product-aligned federated LoRA framework that mitigates aggregation and initialization errors by preserving local factor continuity and aligning products to rank-specific global references, achieving convergence under heterogeneous client ranks.
